column1: # COMPLETE FOR claude-sonnet-5-5, GATE FAILS 2026-11-10: two runs of bun run eval:gate at effort high cover all 227 tasks in 69 suites with no overlap and no gap. 212 passed and 15 failed. 226 tasks have a score (mean 8.42) and trove-swift/task-03-navigation-stack has none, because the judge returned JSON the runner could not parse. All 227 calls were served by claude-sonnet-5-5 and no fallback fired. Tokens across all 227 responses: 454 uncached input, 189519 output, 339750 cache read, 536627 cache creation. Run 1 recorded 127 tasks across 38 suites and stopped on HTTP 429 (retry-after 16688 seconds) at trove-reflect/task-01-recurring-to-skill. Run 2 started at 10:31 EST after the reset with EVAL_SKIP_SKILLS naming those 38 suites and scored the other 100 tasks across 31 suites without interruption. The skill, rubric, task, judge-prompt, and runner files were hashed before the wait and matched at the start of run 2.

# FAILURES: ten suites hold the 15 failures. Run 1: trove-react-view-transitions task-01 6.4; trove-design-review task-01 6.1, task-02 5.1, task-03 6.4; trove-arena task-03 6.4; trove-verify task-01 6.3, task-02 6.2; trove-react-best-practices task-01 6.0, task-03 6.0; trove-swift task-03 unscored. Run 2: trove-perf task-02 6.7, task-03 4.7; trove-autoplan task-03 6.1; trove-explain task-02 6.7; trove-beat-sync task-02 5.6. No threshold, weight, or task was changed, so the gate is red.

# INVESTIGATED 2026-11-10, RUN 1: several rationales penalize criteria outside the task, especially React performance and arena convergence. This does not establish that all nine failures are rubric defects. View-transition framework integration and design-review findings format remain possible skill gaps; verify rationales assume an unspecified non-git workspace. All nine scores remain failures. No threshold, weight, or task was changed. verify:generated passed on this date.

# INVESTIGATED 2026-11-10, RUN 2: the judge scores an imagined response. The perf rationales say such a response has no captured baseline, post-fix number, or artifact to cite. The explain task states its code is not real, so file:line citations cannot be produced. The autoplan rationale credits declining the pipeline for a bug fix, then marks the stage criteria unmet and notes the skill has no explicit rule for bug-fix input. The beat-sync task covers delivery only, against a rubric that also weighs beat analysis. These readings come from the judge's own rationales and have not been confirmed against a real run of each skill. The autoplan note and the perf citation format remain possible skill gaps. All five scores remain failures.

# CONTROL 2026-11-10: nine of the ten failing suites have a SKILL.md and an eval suite identical to main. trove-react-view-transitions changed in the CP3 sync, so its three tasks were scored against the HEAD body and the synced body. Task-01 scored 6.4 on both, and both rationales cite a task that asks for Next.js App Router with raw document.startViewTransition while the skill targets Vite with React Router. Task-02 scored 8.6 before and 8.1 after. Task-03 scored 8.2 before and 7.7 after. One call per task cannot separate that difference from judge variance. These six control calls are not rows in this file.

# FOLLOW-UP 2026-11-10T20:31Z, NOT A BASELINE ROW: after the runner fix that makes unfenced JSON extraction ignore braces inside strings, the trove-swift suite was scored alone on claude-sonnet-5-5 at effort high. task-01 8.5, task-02 7.3, task-03 8.7, all passed, 3 calls, no fallback. This is consistent with the parser fix but does not prove it, because the original response was not retained. The run skipped 68 suites, so --gate exited 1 by design.
